title: Klondike Solitaire Pro
description: Enjoy a stylish version of the Klondike card game. A modern reiteration of this classic Solitaire game with undo, hints and many themes to choose from! Solitaire is an exciting way to pass the time - anywhere, any time. Whether you are at home on lazy day, at the office taking a break, or outside with your laptop soaking in the sun, spice up your day with a game of solitaire. Escape a mundane task with a quick win that will rejuvenate your spirit!
instructions: The object of this strategy game is to place all of the cards into the four foundations at the top The cards in each foundation slot must be of the same suit and in ascending order Ace to King To achieve this stack the cards on the tableau in descend
